claims.text: Refeeding syndrome: serious metabolic derangement w hypophosphatemia and other electrolyte abnormalities; rare, mostly in the most undernourished
claims.quote: Refeeding syndrome, a potentially serious metabolic derangement characterized by hypophosphatemia and other electrolyte abnormalities, occurs rarely and particularly among the most undernourished patients

claims.text: Follow closely for refeeding syndrome; monitor electrolytes closely
claims.quote: Patients should be followed carefully for signs of refeeding syndrome and electrolytes closely monitored.

claims.text: ASPEN: thiamine 100 mg before dextrose-based solutions
claims.quote: ASPEN’s proposed guidelines recommend 100 mg of thiamine supplementation before dextrose-based solutions.
